太大了，太小了 (Chinese (Simplified)) 沙努太大了，妈妈背不动她，沙努太小了，不能自己去上学。那么你呢？太大了，还是太小了？ This is a Level 1 book for children who are eager to begin reading. Pratham Books goes digital to weave a whole new chapter in the realm of multilingual children's stories. Knitting together children, authors, illustrators and publishers. Folding in teachers, and translators. To create a rich fabric of openly licensed multilingual stories for the children of India and the world. Our unique online platform, StoryWeaver, is a playground where children, parents, teachers and librarians can get creative. Come, start weaving today, and help us get a book in every child's hand!

dimensions.literacy: 太大/太小、能/不能反复对比，家庭称谓和孩子具体能力形成关联；短句易预测。
dimensions.story: 先用成人相反评价制造困惑，再从各家人的爱里得到接纳，结尾大拥抱回应问题，温暖有趣。
